User.authority: issuer and subject linked to a personal business account
User.lifetime: A disabled user cannot authenticate; the account identifier continues to identify financial facts.

Organization.authority: business account with current membership, role and resource ACL
Organization.lifetime: Membership can be removed and restored; earlier content ACLs do not return automatically.

Node.authority: registered supplier owner; connection separately proves the current credential
Node.lifetime: Offline, quarantined or revoked devices retain their identity and execution history.

ModelVersion.authority: platform reviewed model and execution profile
ModelVersion.lifetime: An immutable version and weights digest may be used by several reviewed profiles. Eligibility is checked on the profile.

Job.authority: paying owner; user-facing status requires current requester identity
Job.lifetime: Terminal execution and financial settlement are separate; content deletion does not grant new job access.

Attempt.authority: Job owner through the Job; a provider needs the active fenced lease
Attempt.lifetime: Unconfirmed execution or cleanup is unknown. The attempt cannot be used as proof of payout or permission to retry.

Artifact.authority: business owner plus uploader and any applicable resource ACL
Artifact.lifetime: Publication grants no permanent right to read. Tombstones and source revocation are checked on use.

Ledger.authority: financial account; balanced immutable postings are written by the control plane
Ledger.lifetime: Logout, account access loss or deleting an artifact cannot erase prior postings. Corrections use new transactions.
